title: Programme Manager
description: Programme Manager, QinetiQ. Boscombe Down, Amesbury. Permanent full time. £66,150 - £73,500 + benefits. Minimum average site attendance of 3 days per week. Deliver the programme vision, objectives and benefits; manage delivery of trials across the IDT division, portfolio up to £250 million. Integrated planning, budget and cost control with the Portfolio Office, risk and issue management, RAG performance reviews, stakeholder engagement with Finance, Commercial, People, Supply Chain and external. Essential: in-depth programme management knowledge and full project lifecycle; APM PMQ, PMI PgMP or MSP Foundation & Practitioner, or working towards equivalent certification. All applicants must be eligible for SC clearance as a minimum.
